description: This file contains unit tests for the MembershipTableSnapshot class in the Orleans framework, specifically testing silo status retrieval, IAmAliveTime preservation, and handling of unknown silos.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshotTests
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the MembershipTableSnapshot class, verifying silo status retrieval, IAmAliveTime preservation, and handling of unknown silos.
